description: Deputies and senators of a commune given by name or INSEE code. An ambiguous name returns candidate communes. A commune split between several constituencies has several deputies: pass the address longitude and latitude (WGS84) to get the single deputy of that address, as the site's address finder does; none is given within 200 m of a boundary. Without coordinates, the result gives the public geocoder to use for the user's address.
name: find_representatives
title: Find representatives
